what_this_is: How often each input to the clustering updates, and what proves it: a sentence on the provider's own page, a field in a committed artifact, or a measurement made against Earth Engine. Rows with no proof say they have no proof.
rule: интервал не принимается, пока не названо, чем он доказан

worldcover.quote: The website of the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service has undergone a restructuring. Please update your bookmarks.

gls_lcz.quote: The Global Dynamic Land Cover product, with specific regard to the 100 m datasets covering the years 2015-2019, offers annual global land cover maps and cover fraction layers, providing a detailed view of land cover at three classification levels.
gls_lcz.also: Built upon the Global Dynamic Land Cover dataset, the Copernicus Global Land Cover and Tropical Forest Mapping and Monitoring Service (LCFM) not only extends the time series of the 100 m Copernicus Global Land Cover layers (2015-2019), but also enhances the existing service by delivering a high-resolution (10 m), dynamic global land cover service (2020-2026). The 10 m Global Land Cover Map (LCM) for 2020 and the 10 m Pan-Tropical Tree Cover Density (TCD) for 2020 are already available.

worldclim.quote: This is WorldClim version 2.1 climate data for 1970-2000. This version was released in January 2020.
worldclim.also: This version supersedes version 1.4, which is still available.

viirs.quote: A new consistently processed time series of annual global VIIRS nighttime lights has been produced from monthly cloud-free average radiance grids spanning 2012* to 2020.
viirs.also: * The latest update is VNL v2.2.
